abstract: In this study, we employ time series techniques to estimate the aggregate production function for China. Combined with labor force input with or without quality adjustment, the three estimated capital stock series then formed six groups of time series data. Using Chinese aggregate time series from the period of 1952–2024, unit root tests and tests of cointegration are performed for the variables involved. Both Structural Vector Auto Regression (SVAR) and State Space models are used to estimate the parameters of China’s aggregate production function. The estimated long-run output elasticity supports the view that there has been a slowdown in productivity growth under the conditions of labor quality adjustment in recent years in the aggregate Chinese economy, together with diminishing returns to scale in factor inputs.

title: Production function estimation for China: A State Space time series analysis considering quality of labor forces
title_zh: 中国生产函数估计：考虑劳动力质量的状态空间时间序列分析

abstract: Rational actors constantly incorporate information into their decision‐making behavior. Since there is often a time lag between the announcement of a policy and its implementation, an important question arises: when do rational actors incorporate new information into their market behavior, at the announcement or at the implementation of a policy? We investigate this question using the easing of trade tensions between China and the United States, marked by the “Phase One” trade deal announced in December 2019 and signed in January 2020, as a considerable positive trade shock. Focusing on two key events, the announcement of substantial tariff reductions on December 13, 2019, and the signing of the trade deal in January 2020, this study examines how both the announcement and the implementation of reduced trade barriers affected agricultural companies' stock prices. We employ an event study approach using data from the MSCI ACWI Select Agriculture Producers Investable Market Index to assess market reactions. The findings are consistent with the hypothesis derived from the conceptual framework, showing that rational market actors incorporate information at the announcement stage, not only at the implementation of a policy. However, sub‐industry analyses indicate that a subset of sub‐industries drives the aggregate effect, while additional heterogeneity analysis shows that the magnitude of the effects differs across continents. These findings are relevant for policymakers, businesses, and economists seeking to understand the broader economic implications of international trade agreements in general, and trade disputes in particular.
abstract_zh: 理性行为者不断将信息纳入其决策行为之中。由于政策从宣布到实施往往存在时间差，一个关键问题随之产生：理性行为者是在政策宣布时还是实施时，将新信息融入其市场行为？本文以2019年12月宣布、2020年1月签署的“第一阶段”贸易协议为标志的中美贸易紧张局势缓和作为一次显著的正向贸易冲击，对此问题进行探究。研究聚焦于两个关键事件——2019年12月13日宣布大幅削减关税及2020年1月贸易协议的签署，考察贸易壁垒降低的宣布与实施如何影响农业企业的股价。我们采用事件研究法，利用MSCI ACWI精选农业生产者投资市场指数的数据评估市场反应。研究结果与概念框架推导出的假设一致，表明理性市场行为者在政策宣布阶段即纳入信息，而非仅在政策实施时。然而，子行业分析显示，总体效应由部分子行业驱动，而进一步的异质性分析表明，效应大小在不同大洲间存在差异。这些发现对政策制定者、企业及经济学家理解国际贸易协定（尤其是贸易争端）的更广泛经济影响具有参考价值。

title: Rational Expectations and Market Timing: An Event Study of the China–United States Phase One Trade Deal
title_zh: 理性预期与市场择时：中美第一阶段贸易协议的事件研究

abstract: Skill shortages are a type of skill mismatch whereby employers are unable to fill existing vacancies due to a lack of suitably qualified or skilled candidates. Despite representing a significant concern for policymakers, the literature on skill shortages is highly underdeveloped, as a result of a lack of clarity and consistency on how skill shortages are defined and measured. In this study, using data from the 2021 European Skills and Jobs Survey combined with Lightcast job advertisement data, we attempt to bridge the methodological gap by developing a measure of potential skill shortages that can be readily replicated across countries over time. Benchmarking an objective measurement approach to a dataset reflecting the current distribution of skills and competencies being utilized within the labour market constitutes, in our view, a novelty within the skill shortages measurement literature. We estimate that approximately two per cent of vacancies in the EU are likely to experience skill shortages. We find substantial variation in estimates across occupations and countries. Moreover, potential skill shortages tend to be in occupations within which the skill content is changing more rapidly over time. Acknowledgements We would like to express our gratitude to the participants of the Cedefop research conference ‘ Using data from the web to shape next-generation labour market and skills analysis’ , hosted by the European Economic and Social Committee (Brussels, April 2025) for their invaluable feedback and constructive suggestions.
abstract_zh: 技能短缺是一种技能错配类型，即雇主因缺乏具备适当资格或技能的候选人而无法填补现有职位空缺。尽管这已成为政策制定者关注的重要问题，但由于对技能短缺的定义和测量缺乏清晰性和一致性，相关文献仍极为不完善。本研究利用2021年欧洲技能与就业调查数据，结合Lightcast招聘广告数据，试图通过开发一种可随时跨国家、跨时间复制的潜在技能短缺测量方法来弥合方法论上的差距。我们认为，将客观测量方法对标于反映劳动力市场中当前技能与能力分布状况的数据集，是技能短缺测量文献中的一项创新。我们估计，欧盟约2%的职位空缺可能面临技能短缺。研究发现，不同职业和国家之间的估计值存在显著差异。此外，潜在技能短缺往往集中在技能内容随时间变化更快的职业中。致谢：我们谨向欧洲经济社会委员会主办的Cedefop研究会议“利用网络数据塑造下一代劳动力市场与技能分析”（布鲁塞尔，2025年4月）的与会者表示诚挚感谢，感谢他们宝贵的反馈和建设性建议。
title: Developing a new European indicator of potential skill shortages
title_zh: 构建欧洲潜在技能短缺新指标

abstract: The seminal 1987 paper by Mathewson and Winter demonstrates that the competitive effects of exclusive dealing depend on firm asymmetries. Revisiting their model with linear demand and constant marginal costs, we show that the equilibrium adoption and welfare impact of exclusive dealing are fully characterized by two sufficient statistics: the standalone surplus ratio (capturing the dominant firm's competitive advantage) and the geometric mean of demand diversion ratios (measuring product substitutability). Exclusive dealing is more likely to arise and harm consumer surplus when competitive advantage is stronger and products are closer substitutes. A stronger competitive advantage also raises the likelihood that exclusive dealing reduces social welfare, while the effect of substitutability on welfare is non‐monotonic. We also show that both competitive advantage and substitutability can be empirically recovered from diversion ratios and market shares under the no‐exclusive dealing regime.
abstract_zh: Mathewson和Winter在1987年的开创性论文表明，排他性交易的竞争效应取决于企业的不对称性。通过在线性需求和恒定边际成本下重新审视其模型，我们证明排他性交易的均衡采纳及其福利影响完全由两个充分统计量刻画：独立剩余比率（反映主导企业的竞争优势）和需求转移率的几何平均值（衡量产品替代性）。当竞争优势更强且产品更接近替代品时，排他性交易更可能发生并损害消费者剩余。更强的竞争优势也提高了排他性交易降低社会福利的可能性，而替代性对福利的影响则是非单调的。我们还表明，在无排他性交易制度下，竞争优势和替代性均可通过转移率和市场份额进行实证估计。
title: A re‐examination of the competitive effects of exclusive dealing
title_zh: 独家交易的竞争效应再考察

abstract: We analyze how a regulator can learn about the \textit{aggregate} health of banks by asking \textit{individual} banks to understand and communicate risks. Focused learning (banks report on the same risks) disciplines banks, yielding higher quality information. Broad learning (reporting on different risks) yields better coverage of information. The information gain from either approach is undermined by banks reducing their exposure to designated risks, resulting in correlated risk exposures and regulatory blind spots. Having each bank report on all risks appears to combine the benefits of focused and broad learning -- but instead increases strategic complementarities across banks and weakens discipline.
abstract_zh: 我们分析监管者如何通过要求个别银行理解和沟通风险，来了解银行的总体健康状况。聚焦式学习（银行报告相同的风险）对银行形成约束，产生更高质量的信息。广泛式学习（报告不同的风险）则能提供更全面的信息覆盖。然而，这两种方式带来的信息增益都会因银行减少对指定风险的敞口而受损，导致风险敞口相关化及监管盲区。让每家银行报告所有风险看似结合了聚焦式与广泛式学习的优势——但实际上却加剧了银行间的战略互补性，削弱了约束力。
title: Broad and focused learning

abstract: We develop a model of bias and information loss in supervisory communication and apply it to evaluate a policy reform that delegated supervisory decision-making authority over a subset of bank branches to a lower level. Affected branches become 57-80\% more likely to face supervisory intervention, implying substantial efficiency gains arising from improved detection of banking misconduct and more accurate assessments of its severity. The evidence is inconsistent with alternative explanations, including increased supervisory stringency or greater risk-taking by banks. Our analysis highlights decentralization benefits within supervisory hierarchies specifically, and speaks to the optimal organizational design for fraud detection more broadly.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于监管沟通中偏见与信息损失的模型，并将其应用于评估一项政策改革，该改革将部分银行分支机构的监管决策权下放至较低层级。受影响的分支机构面临监管干预的可能性增加了57%-80%，这表明通过提高对银行不当行为的检测能力及其严重性评估的准确性，带来了显著的效率提升。证据与替代解释不符，包括监管严格性增强或银行风险承担增加。我们的分析特别强调了监管层级内部权力下放的益处，并更广泛地涉及欺诈检测的最优组织设计。
title: Subordinates in Charge: Does Delegation Improve Bank Supervision?
title_zh: 下属掌权：授权能否改善银行监管？

abstract: This article provides an overview of the literature on financial literacy. It covers the initial measurement that created the Big Three questions and measures of personal finance knowledge featuring 28 questions. It shows that levels of financial literacy are low and have not been improving over time. This is true not only in the United States but also in countries worldwide. These findings matter because financial literacy is conducive to savvy financial behaviors, from holding precautionary savings to planning for retirement to many other financial decisions. Financial education programs have grown exponentially over time, providing important insights into their cost-effectiveness. Personal finance courses have been added to high school and college curricula, and the evidence indicates that they are useful initiatives to improve financial knowledge and downstream behavior.
abstract_zh: 本文对金融素养相关文献进行了综述。文章涵盖了最初构建“三大问题”的测量方法，以及包含28个问题的个人财务知识测量指标。研究表明，金融素养水平普遍较低，且随时间推移并未得到改善。这一现象不仅存在于美国，也见于全球各国。这些发现之所以重要，是因为金融素养有助于促进明智的财务行为，从持有预防性储蓄到规划退休，乃至其他诸多财务决策。金融教育项目数量呈指数级增长，为其成本效益提供了重要见解。个人理财课程已被纳入高中和大学课程体系，证据表明，这些举措在提升金融知识及后续行为方面颇具成效。
title: Improving Financial Literacy: From Corporate Finance to Personal Finance
title_zh: 提升金融素养：从公司金融到个人金融

abstract: Economic historians have long placed culture at the centre of the rise of the West, but have lacked a measure of culture spanning the emergence of modern growth. Using 23,064 historical books, this column constructs an ‘innovation wedge’ that separates the values texts endorse from the social arrangements they merely depict. The wedge falls by 51% between 1000 and 1920. In a calibrated growth model, that decline accounts for about two-thirds of the first sustained acceleration in productivity growth between 1500 and 1700.
abstract_zh: 经济史学家长期以来将文化置于西方崛起之核心，但一直缺乏一种能够跨越现代增长兴起的文化度量。本文利用23,064本历史书籍，构建了一个“创新楔子”，用以区分文本所推崇的价值观与仅作为描绘对象的社会安排。该楔子在1000年至1920年间下降了51%。在一个校准的增长模型中，这一下降解释了1500年至1700年间生产率增长首次持续加速的大约三分之二。
title: Nine centuries of cultural change and the productivity of ideas
title_zh: 九个世纪的文化变迁与思想生产力

abstract: Many public institutions are now experimenting with AI tools to support surveillance, supervision, and policy analysis, raising questions about which analytical tasks can be delegated to machines and which still require expert judgement. Comparing several GPT models with IMF economists’ assessments of Article IV staff reports, this column shows that today’s best models perform well on structured, factual tasks but remain less reliable on nuanced rating questions, where human judgement still matters.
abstract_zh: 许多公共机构正尝试运用人工智能工具来辅助监控、监管及政策分析，这引发了关于哪些分析任务可交由机器处理、哪些仍需专家判断的疑问。通过对比多种GPT模型与国际货币基金组织经济学家对第四条磋商工作人员报告的评估，本专栏指出，当前最先进的模型在结构化、事实性任务上表现出色，但在涉及细微差别的评级问题上仍不够可靠，这些领域人类的判断依然至关重要。
title: Macrofinance meets AI: Evaluating alignment between LLMs and economists
title_zh: 宏观金融遇上人工智能：评估大语言模型与经济学家之间的一致性
